description: This file defines an abstract class InstallerCommand within the OrangeHRM framework that extends a console Command. It overrides the run method to include predefined behavior for checking if the system is already installed and logging errors.

classes.name: InstallerCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for installer commands handling installation logic and error logging within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Overrides the parent run method to include a check for existing installation and error logging.
